title: Role Help
description: Makes it way easier to mention a group of people.

entries.description: Starts a vote to add the given role. Put quotation marks around multi-word roles and the description. (Ex: !role add "Example Role" "Example role description")
Cancels a vote for the given role, but only if you initiated it or are the admin. Put quotation marks around multi-word roles. (Ex: !role cancel "Example Role")
[Admin Only] Sets the description for the given role.
